correctness.rationale: The exact photon-budget identity bounds every positive steady state in rescaled L1. Positivity of the one-dimensional elliptic resolvent yields a uniform Linfty bound, hence uniform C2 compactness for all equilibrium branches. A zero scalar limit contradicts the strictly positive invasion principal eigenvalue. The Wronskian proves uniqueness of the positive scalar limit, while a strict sign for the shooting derivative and alpha>0 make the full two-dimensional shooting Jacobian invertible. Compactness excludes remote equilibria, so the implicit-function branch is the unique coupled positive equilibrium for all sufficiently large finite shading. The first-order nutrient correction is obtained from the exact Neumann–Robin Poisson problem. Running verify.py from the package returned VERIFY_OK, but numerical samples are not used as a proof.

value.rationale: The 2024 source explicitly identifies general disease-free uniqueness as unresolved and ties it to ambiguity in viral reproduction-number definitions. A natural physically motivated strong-shading subregime yields a rigorous unique coupled positive stationary profile, nontrivial positive inverse-attenuation biomass, and explicit nutrient depletion, uniformly across all positive equilibria. This resolves a meaningful two-field structural gap; it is not the earlier scalar profile theorem, a routine normalization, or an arbitrary finite parameter value.
